chris-pimentel.text: As chair of a South Bay Cities COG committee in December 2025, favored the COG staying agnostic on the South Bay light rail route (Hawthorne Blvd. vs. railroad right-of-way); a motion to stay neutral passed.

source.title: The South Bay Cities Council of Governments remains neutral on South Bay light rail route - Easy Reader (Dec 11, 2025)

chris-pimentel.text: Per a Citizen Portal AI summary of the June 2025 meeting, the council created a charter-city study commission and appointed Mayor Pimentel and Mayor Pro Tem Baldino to explore a possible 2026 charter measure.

source.title: Council creates city charter commission (El Segundo, June 17, 2025) - Citizen Portal AI meeting summary

ryan-w-baldino.text: Housing: "The challenge isn't whether we should build housing. It's how we build it." Notes RHNA rose to 521 units; says decisions shouldn't be "driven solely by state mandates" and new state laws reduce local control.

source.title: Ryan Baldino for El Segundo City Council (campaign site, 'Where He Stands')

ryan-w-baldino.text: Supports keeping El Segundo's own police and fire departments while facing long-term costs; says the city has addressed unfunded pension liabilities and he will continue so safety services "are funded wisely."

source.title: Ryan Baldino for El Segundo City Council (campaign site, 'Where He Stands')

ryan-w-baldino.text: Formed a Hyperion ad hoc subcommittee in 2023 and testified in Sacramento for AB 1216, signed in 2023, making fence-line hydrogen sulfide monitoring permanent and public in real time.

source.title: Ryan Baldino for El Segundo City Council (campaign site, 'Where He Stands')

ryan-w-baldino.text: Chaired the ESUSD Citizens' Bond Oversight Committee; pledges to keep a collaborative City-ESUSD relationship including joint-use agreements, crossing guards and library services.

source.title: Ryan Baldino for El Segundo City Council (campaign site, 'Where He Stands')

ryan-w-baldino.text: Per a Citizen Portal AI summary of the June 2025 meeting, appointed with Mayor Pimentel to a commission exploring a possible 2026 charter-city measure.

source.title: Council creates city charter commission (El Segundo, June 17, 2025) - Citizen Portal AI meeting summary

john-pickhaver.text: Says decades of under-zoning caused El Segundo's housing shortage; laws like SB 9 and SB 79 "are not the cause" but "the consequence." Backs mixed-use housing east of PCH near jobs and transit while protecting single-family neighborhoods.

source.title: John Pickhaver for El Segundo City Council 2026 (campaign site, priorities and endorsements)

john-pickhaver.text: Notes nearly 60% of residents rent; says he would be the council's only renter, Millennial and registered Democrat.

source.title: John Pickhaver for El Segundo City Council 2026 (campaign site, priorities and endorsements)

john-pickhaver.text: Proposes a Safe Intersections Initiative (four-way stops, crosswalks, traffic calming) and proactive e-bike and NEV rules, faulting the city's wait-and-see approach to the South Bay Bicycle Master Plan.

source.title: John Pickhaver for El Segundo City Council 2026 (campaign site, priorities and endorsements)

john-pickhaver.text: Supports keeping ESPD and ESFD in-house but cites a racial-profiling lawsuit and says surveillance tech like license plate readers and drones must not compromise privacy or civil liberties.

source.title: John Pickhaver for El Segundo City Council 2026 (campaign site, priorities and endorsements)

john-pickhaver.text: Helped mobilize residents against a 230,780 sq. ft. AI data center relying on an old EIR; calls for holding Chevron and Hyperion accountable "as federal oversight diminishes under the Trump administration."

source.title: John Pickhaver for El Segundo City Council 2026 (campaign site, priorities and endorsements)

john-pickhaver.text: Says being business-friendly "doesn't mean every development is right for every location"; supports outdoor dining and pedestrian improvements downtown.

source.title: John Pickhaver for El Segundo City Council 2026 (campaign site, priorities and endorsements)

john-pickhaver.text: Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Democratic Party.
